subject: where are my cups??
body:
Hi, I ordered cups last week and still haven't gotten them. Can you check on it? We're running low.

Mele
needs_human_reason: Order status answered straight from order history (shipped, in transit, tracking and ETA on file).
summary: 'Where are my cups?' Order UQ-10482 shipped 3/4 via UPS, in transit, estimated delivery Tue 3/9. The customer is running low.
draft_reply:
Hi Mele,

Good news: your cups are on the way and scheduled to arrive tomorrow. Order UQ-10482 (5 cases of 8 oz striped cups + 2 cases of paper lids) shipped Thursday, March 4 via UPS, with an estimated delivery of Tuesday, March 9.

Tracking number: 1Z84X9A20391827364

If it hasn't shown up by end of day Tuesday, just reply here and we'll jump on it.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: 'Ordered cups last week' matched to UQ-10482 (ordered 3/3); the earlier order UQ-10461 was delivered 2/11.
